item.title: Religion Online Redesign
item.description: Marking twenty years since the original launch of Religion Online, we are excited to announce our newly redesigned and updated website.

item.title: Twentieth Anniversary
item.description: To celebrate the 20th anniversary of the birth of Religion Online we are proud to share David P. Polk's God of Empowering Love: A History and Reconception of the Theodicy Conundrum.

item.title: Special Lecture by John Cobb
item.description: In this special lecture, John Cobb explores the central the message of Jesus, "God's Kingdom."

item.title: April Showers Will (hopefully) Bring May (and beyond) Flowers
item.description: After a longer than expected hiatus, we will begin posting new additions to this website very soon. Our hope is that they will just be the beginning of fresh content for years to come.

item.title: In Support of the Spirituality of Earthism
item.description: In last two millennia at least four forms of spirituality have been dominant in the West. The relatively recent emergence of a new form, Earthism, is a positive development that not only benefits our planet but also gives meaning to our lives.

item.title: May Musings
item.description: Religion is deeply intertwined with a number of significant events that took place in May and are observed around most of the world. From International Workers Day to Mother's Day, this post explores a handful of religious commemorations.

item.title: Revaluing the Values of Science, Religion, and Education
item.description: We need sciences, religions, and educational institutions that recognize the great need for people to value the natural world, are committed to preserving and renewing our earthly home, and oriented around the objective of creating an ecological civilization.

item.title: A Month of Peace
item.description: At a time when Muslims are too-often portrayed in negative light, it would benefit us all very much to learn about faithful practitioners, like Badshah Khan, who believe that the way of peace is deeply woven in the fibers of Islam, the religion of peace.
